answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in opal, expire in atlas, and ledge lists each expiry. Anyone running 50 aliases as a result needs 51 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2157 identities would post 3499 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
